description: Voiries de la commune de Chateauroux is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by CHATEAUROUX METROPOLE. This road dataset contains: track labels, the date of the deliberation of the Municipal Council when known. Coverage: CHATEAUROUX METROPOLE. The portal shows the English title as "Roads of the commune of Chateauroux" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is CHATEAUROUX METROPOLE. Its keywords include transports-deplacements, reseau-routier, environnement, voirie, voies. The listing shows 4 download or service links in JSON, ZIP, CSV. The listing shows 2024-08-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
